ModMetaData.name: Set my Defaults (and more)
ModMetaData.author: juliusberger00
ModMetaData.description:
Set something up once, save it as a default, and it is applied from then on: bills on new workbenches, filters on new shelves and stockpiles, plants on new growing zones and hydroponics, schedule, work and policies on new colonists, and your policies and colony settings (medical care, auto home area, auto rebuild, manual priorities) in new games.
Every preset lives in one library outside your saves, so it follows you into every colony. Presets from older versions are imported once; the old files stay untouched. Presets that need a mod you no longer run are kept and say which mod.
Nothing happens to colonists, buildings or zones you already have. Each area (workbenches and shelves, zones, colonists, policies, colony settings, library) can be switched off as a whole in the settings.
Needs Harmony and JB Framework. Works with Nice Bill Tab, Nice Inventory Tab, No Max Bills Redux, Project RimFactory, Blueprints Forked, Free Will and Better Workbench Management. Multiplayer: not supported, untested.
Built and tested on RimWorld 1.7. The 1.6 build is best effort and untested (1.6 keeps the previous version and needs no framework).
Made with the help of Claude Code. Code: https://github.com/jb-rimworld/set-my-defaults (MIT).
